correctness.rationale: Each occupied site contributes two nondefect bonds, so K_n=n−2Ση_i and has the required parity. A nonempty cyclic defect set has a unique spin reconstruction exactly when consecutive defect gaps are odd: a 00 fixes the spin and between defects the spin alternates. Zero defects instead give two alternating states, only for even n. The cyclic independent-set coefficients a_{n,k} have a_{n,k}/n^k→2^{1−k}/k! and a_{n,k}≤2n^k/k! for admissible k. After removing z_n^{n/2}, the weighted count series is dominated by 2M^k/k! with M bounding n/√z_n; its fixed-k terms tend to 2λ^k/k!, including the even k=0 term. This proves the normalizations, tail and bounded first moment. At fixed positive k all allowed configurations have equal weight. In ordered coordinates there are exactly two alternating parity patterns; the closing gap is then odd by k≡n mod 2. The parity-grid Riemann sums have factor 2^{1−k}, which cancels on conditioning to give uniform order statistics. Combining with the count tails yields weak convergence of finite point measures on the circle. The exact spin identity gives the arc parity sign and E S_i=−E K_n/n tends to zero. Replacing a fixed arc by the moving arc changes its expected count by O(|d_n/n−x|+1/n) using rotation invariance and the bounded first moment. The limiting arc counts have no boundary atoms; projecting two independent Poisson arc counts onto total parity gives the stated H_p and the covariance prefactor four. In the superquadratic regime the same factorial bound shows relative tails vanish against the weight 2 for k=0 or n/√z_n for k=1; rotation makes the sole defect uniform. The frozen finite diagnostics were inspected, not rerun.

originality.rationale: Best of current knowledge for the grand-canonical spatial crossover on the hard-core ring. The scalar coefficients are known and already imply the count asymptotic after factorial domination. The parity expectation formula is elementary once the spatial limit is available. The supported distinct contribution is the spatial limit under the cyclic odd-gap constraint and the resulting joint account of the macroscopic behavior in both parity sectors. A later canonical diffraction record proves the fixed-defect spatial step by a different representation, so that conditional result is not distinct from all indexed work; this match is not evidence of prior coverage before the frozen record.

value.rationale: A fugacity of order n² is where an equilibrium hard-core ring goes from visible random frustrated bonds to an almost perfectly alternating order. The point process identifies where the defects are, including the unavoidable odd-sector defect, rather than merely inferring a count from a known partition polynomial. It also distinguishes symmetric from antisymmetric staggered covariance without a new correlation calculation for every separation.
residual_risks: The statement does not treat interactions beyond nearest-neighbor exclusion, kinetic adsorption, or microscopic-distance covariance asymptotics.
